selected_evidence.summary: Established OS/kernel, installed package versions, disk layout, absence of pre-existing LVM or `/srv/data`, SSH health, SELinux enforcement, configuration checksums, and original boot ID.

selected_evidence.requirement: Create a logical volume mounted at /srv/data
selected_evidence.summary: Created the PV/VG/LV and mounted its XFS filesystem read-write at `/srv/data` through a validated UUID-based fstab entry.

selected_evidence.requirement: Grow the logical volume online to at least 2 GB
selected_evidence.summary: The mounted LV grew online from 805,306,368 to 2,143,289,344 bytes. LVM detected mounted XFS and invoked `xfs_growfs`; the resulting filesystem is 2,076,180,480 bytes.
SHA-256 digests for the text and 16 MiB binary preservation files matched exactly before and after growth.

selected_evidence.requirement: Preserve swap and administrative access during conversion
selected_evidence.summary: A 2 GiB root-only swap file replaced the retired partition; SSH remained active, enabled, and listening, with no failed units before restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline and acknowledgement
selected_evidence.summary: Captured healthy baseline with boot ID `4ebdfa06-919e-48a9-8a15-475d9007662c`; systemd acknowledged the delayed reboot, after which the command stream closed.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 mandatory restart: changed boot identity and recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Blocked: representative early and final recovery probes timed out. No changed boot ID or post-restart service, mount, LVM, swap, and data proof could be captured, so restart persistence is not claimed.

' '--- pre-restart boot identity ---'; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf '%s
' '--- OS/kernel unchanged ---'; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s
' "$PRETTY_NAME" "$(uname -r)"; printf '%s
' '--- required service/access health ---'; systemctl is-active sshd; systemctl is-enabled sshd; ss -tlnp | grep ':22 '; systemctl --failed --no-pager; printf '%s
' '--- persistent storage configuration validation ---'; findmnt --verify --verbose; tail -5 /etc/fstab; printf '%s
' '--- live LVM/filesystem/data health ---'; pvs --units b --nosuffix -o pv_name,pv_size,pv_free; vgs --units b --nosuffix -o vg_name,vg_size,vg_free; lvs --units b --nosuffix -o lv_name,vg_name,lv_size,lv_attr,devices; findmnt -T /srv/data -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS,UUID; df -B1 /srv/data; sha256sum /srv/data/preservation.txt /srv/data/preservation.bin; grep -Fx 'This file must survive the online LVM and XFS growth.' /srv/data/preservation.txt; printf '%s
' '--- replacement swap health ---'; swapon --show=NAME,TYPE,SIZE,USED,PRIO --bytes; printf '%s
' '--- protected config checksums ---'; sha256sum /etc/ssh/sshd_config /etc/fstab
